rows.case into while body: switch (k) { case 0: while (n < 3) { s += 10; case 1: s += 1; ++n; } }
rows.case into for body, expression init: switch (k) { case 0: for (n = 1; n < 3; ++n) { s += 10; case 1: s += 1; } }
rows.case into for body, declaration init wit: switch (k) { case 0: for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { s += 10; case 1: s += 1; n = i; } }
rows.case into do body: switch (k) { case 0: do { s += 10; case 1: s += 1; } while (++n < 3); }
